sources.title: Philippine Registry of Cultural Property (NCCA): Naga City entries
sources.note: Inspected October 8, 2026. Minor Basilica of Our Lady of Peñafrancia of Naga: local cultural property under Ordinance No. 2003-003. The registry listing is the basis for this landmark's Heritage legend membership.

text.en: Construction began in 1976, and the basilica was completed in 1981.
The Holy See granted the church the title of minor basilica in 1985.
The basilica houses the venerated image of Our Lady of Peñafrancia.
Its stained-glass windows tell the story of Marian devotion in Bicol.
